verdict.rationale: Honeycomb offers threshold-based Triggers and SLO alerts (periodic condition checks) and an API for building custom automation, but there is no evidence of a scheduler for recurring jobs/workflows (e.g., cron-like scheduled queries, scheduled reports, or workflow orchestration) that an AI-native user could configure. missing for 10: scheduled/recurring query or workflow execution feature, evidence of job scheduling API or UI, any cron-style automation beyond alert triggers.
